text: Half the China book on one ETF with a vague rebound thesis; the exit condition is too loose to act on.
Stacked growth-board exposure on top of the CSI 300 buy left China nearly fully invested in correlated risk with generic reasoning.
Removing a short before a binary central-bank event is sound risk control, though no plan for re-entry was stated.
Sizable euro short on a real ECB leadership change, but calling it a shock resignation overstates it and the stop is not specified.
Concentrating the side race into SPY puts is allowed, but expecting a massive breakdown is overconfident and no exit was given.
Clear macro reason with a stated wrong-if, and modest size, but no price stop and the claim that the BoE prepares to cut is unsourced.
Plausible risk-off thesis, but a severe crash overstates a 1.4% Nasdaq drop, and another C$50,000 short stacks correlated dollar-long exposure.
